WITH order_averages AS (
  SELECT
    oe.ordersmark,
    o.timespan,
    AVG(oe.fillcount) AS avg_fill
  FROM orderexecutions AS oe
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY oe.ordersmark, o.timespan
),
with_tif_averages AS (
  SELECT
    ordersmark,
    timespan,
    avg_fill,
    AVG(avg_fill) OVER (PARTITION BY timespan) AS tif_avg_fill,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY timespan ORDER BY avg_fill DESC NULLS LAST) AS fill_rank
  FROM order_averages
)
SELECT
  ordersmark,
  timespan,
  avg_fill,
  avg_fill - tif_avg_fill AS above_tif_average,
  fill_rank
FROM with_tif_averages
WHERE avg_fill > tif_avg_fill
  AND fill_rank <= 3;
